pretraining_artifacts: validation receipt on the exact 5000-event cohort

hashing.manifest_rule: Every required regular file is listed by absolute path, byte length, SHA256, producing job ID, producing contract SHA256, and role; the canonical JSON manifest is itself SHA256-sealed and committed/tagged before use.
hashing.scheduler_evidence_rule: Raw stdout and stderr bytes, argv, exit code, and normalized unique rows are separately SHA256-bound. Nonempty stderr, duplicate rows, missing fields, nonzero query exit, or identity/name/dependency mismatch blocks the program.
hashing.source_immutability_rule: Source manifests before and after must be byte-identical; any mutation blocks promotion.

terminal_evidence_gate.failure_action: Any absent, ambiguous, nonterminal, nonzero, restarted-without-exact-resume-proof, nonfinite, hash-mismatched, or structurally incomplete arm is nonpromotable. Do not infer success from train loss or logs and do not retry under this plan.

paired_q32_relbias_decision.treatment_only: type_conditioned_daughter_relation_bias false for q32 and true for relbias

family_members: teacher-forced edge/complete-target paired promotion endpoint relbias-minus-q32
statistical_gate.gate_rule: All registered family members and guards must be recomputed from exact event-score artifacts. The current aggregate comparator is insufficient.

teacher_forced_guards.definition: Every preregistered teacher-forced accuracy, precision, recall, calibration, and loss endpoint must be finite and nonregressed under a separately sealed direction/margin table; absent endpoint definitions or a failed boolean guard blocks promotion.

paired_q32_relbias_decision.admission: Promote relation bias only if every gate passes. Otherwise retain q32 as the architecture baseline; neither a loss-only win nor an aggregate point estimate alone may promote relbias.

pilot.sample_rule: For each ordered cohort, choose the 64 UIDs with the lowest SHA256 of UTF8('locator-pilot-v1\0' || uid), breaking ties by raw UTF8 bytes.
checks: stable ordered digest before and after
sealed-test and stress indexes never opened
pilot.receipt: Canonical JSON containing cohort binding, selected 64 ordered UIDs, per-UID resolution status, source artifact hashes, zero duplicates/misses, and its own SHA256. Any miss, duplicate, instability, or role mismatch blocks the ladder.

source_pointer_requirements.opt676: Use only the already bound checkpoint/config/split/dataset/selection/terminal closure; fill all currently null architecture, normalizer, state-spec, validation-receipt, selection-receipt, and source-audit fields with exact paths and SHA256s.
source_pointer_requirements.opt1352: After job 16028845 passes the terminal gate, create a candidate pointer with absolute checkpoint path; optimizer step 1352; checkpoint, architecture, config, data, normalizer and state-spec SHA256s; finite audit; exact 5000-UID validation receipt; terminal/runtime/telemetry receipts; and no train-loss selection claim.
source_pointer_requirements.scratch: Create exactly one state with torch_generator_seeded_normal_v1, seed 20260826, the bound MultiGPT constructor/source closure, an architecture-state-spec SHA256, state SHA256, finite audit, and exclusive receipt.

transfer_ladder.normalizer: Fit once from train_order only, bind the train index and ordered-train UID digest, and use byte-identical normalizer parameters for all three arms.

statistics.holm: exact three contrasts separately per mode
statistics.promotion_per_contrast: delta >= 0.01 and CI lower > 0 and Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05
statistics.joint_promotion: contrast must pass in both modes

decision.opt1352: Allowed only when opt1352_minus_opt676 and opt1352_minus_scratch pass jointly; then create the formal immutable selected-pretraining-pointer.v1 with criterion validation_plus_transfer and train_loss_used=false.
decision.opt676: Allowed only when opt676_minus_scratch passes jointly and opt1352_minus_opt676 does not. Stop before HPO because the current HPO builder hard-codes step 1352; require a reviewed generalized-pointer revision.
decision.no_promotion: If scratch is not beaten or evidence is ambiguous/incomplete, stop. Scratch is a diagnostic baseline, not an automatically promotable pretraining pointer.

entry_gate: paired q32/relbias promotion receipt passed or q32-retention receipt sealed
formal selected step-1352 pointer passed validation_plus_transfer
promoted UID replay and pilot passed
real bundle and scheduler/runtime contracts independently cleared
conditional_hpo.current_builder_branch: Only the opt1352-selected branch is compatible with the cleared v2r1 builder.
global_stopping: No automatic retry, requeue, or replacement arm.
A failed or pruned arm consumes its budget and is nonrankable.
Stop without selection if no arm completes step 1094 with finite metrics, hard invariants, and exact 5000-event validation at both steps.
conditional_hpo.promotion_rule: Selection is among completed validation-qualified arms only. Training loss is never a ranking, pruning, or promotion variable.

prerequisites: one completed HPO arm selected by the exact order
new independently reviewed fullscale snapshot and contract
one_final_reconstruction.configuration: Use exactly the selected HPO configuration and source pointer without post-selection tuning; train 1094 optimizer steps and 35008 presentations with one final validation at steps 547 and 1094 on the bound 5000-event validation cohort plus the bound 1000-event rollout cohort.
one_final_reconstruction.claim_limit: This is validation-qualified, not sealed-test-qualified. It may update the validation-best reconstruction pointer but cannot support a final unbiased test-performance claim.

critical_path: 1. Wait for exact terminal evidence for 16030125-16030128 and 16028845; collect and seal manifests without opening sealed-test data.
2. Build event-level q32/relbias evidence and apply the exact matched Holm/bootstrap plus structural, teacher-forced, and efficiency gates.
3. Replay the promoted UID locator, run the deterministic 64-per-cohort locator pilot, and seal all four cohort artifacts.
4. Bind opt1352 and scratch evidence; run the sequential opt676/opt1352/scratch transfer ladder and seal its terminal recommendation.
5. Continue only on the opt1352 branch with the current HPO builder; otherwise stop for a new reviewed contract.
6. Run at most the six fixed HPO arms under midpoint and resource caps; select only among completed validation-qualified arms.
7. Render, review, and separately authorize exactly one fresh final reconstruction; never use train loss or sealed-test evidence for promotion.
